about: Recommended frame generation settings per game for FSR 4.1 Lite's Experimental section. A copy is built into the widget; the widget also reads this file from GitHub every 6 hours. output: fsrfg or xefg. hudFix, hudLimit (1 to 5) and immediate apply to OptiFG only. input (optional) overrides the automatic choice; xboxInput does the same for the Xbox app / Game Pass version. source: rogallylife (tested on a ROG Ally X) or wiki (OptiScaler's game page). The widget adds OptiScaler's own list of games where HUDFix doesn't work.

games.name: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.note: Tested: 47 to 87 FPS. If the HUD flickers, turn on V-Sync in the game.

games.name: Control Ultimate Edition
games.note: Tested: 66 to 94 FPS with XeSS. Keep the game's brightness at default, and Film Grain and Motion Blur off.

games.name: UNCHARTED: Legacy of Thieves Collection
games.note: Tested: about 30 FPS more, with brief HUD ghosting. Keep the game's brightness at default.

games.name: Palworld
games.note: The Xbox app version's own DLSS frame generation is broken, so it uses OptiFG instead.

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.note: With HDR on, XeSS may need r_HDRPipeline=2 in the game's user.cfg.
